newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan coffee prices drop on poor quality.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan coffee prices drop on poor quality.

text.p: Prices at the Kenya coffee auction dropped on Tuesday due to a lower quality of coffee on offer, auction officials said.
Grade ABs averaged $139 per 50-kg bag against $148, grade AAs averaged $144 while grade Cs averaged $133 versus $140.
"The quality of coffee on offer was not so good and there was no pressure by exporters to cover their short positions," a trader said.
The Coffee Board of Kenya said it sold all 22,580 60-kg bags of coffee it had on offer compared with 21,038 sold last week.
